title: Create the following dummy sample files, each as

messages.content:
Create the following dummy sample files, each as small as possible, using your built-in capabilities. Make one separate file per item and show me each so it renders as its own preview card. Don't ask for confirmation — just make them all:

PDF — a one-page sample.pdf with a heading and one sentence. (pdf capability)
Word doc — sample.docx with a title and a paragraph. (document capability)
Excel — sample.xlsx with a small 3×3 table. (spreadsheet capability)
CSV — sample.csv with a few rows. (spreadsheet capability)
Meme image — generate any simple captioned meme. (memes capability)
Voice memo — a text-to-speech mp3 saying "Reveal in folder test." (text-to-speech capability)
Video — use ffmpeg to make a tiny 2-second test mp4 (e.g. testsrc or a solid color). (ffmpeg capability)
Audio — use ffmpeg to make a 1-second tone .wav. (ffmpeg capability)
Keep everything in the workspace files folder. After each, show it inline so I can see its card.

![drake meme](wolffish-media://uploads/memes/drake-1781502113118.png)All 9 done. Here's the rundown:

| # | File | Capability | Size |
|---|------|-----------|------|
| 1 | **sample.pdf** | pdf | 1 page, 972 B |
| 2 | **sample.docx** | document | 8.6 KB |
| 3 | **sample.xlsx** | spreadsheet | 3×3 table |
| 4 | **sample.csv** | spreadsheet | 3 rows |
| 5 | **Meme** | memes | Drake template |
| 6 | **Voice memo** | text-to-speech | 15 KB MP3 |
| 7 | **sample.mp4** | ffmpeg | 12 KB, 2s test pattern |
| 8 | **sample.wav** | ffmpeg | 86 KB, 1s 440 Hz tone |

Everything's in `~/.wolffish/workspace/files/` except the voice memo — the TTS tool puts those in `speech/` by design, can't override the path. If you want it moved, say the word.
